name: Find a name worth rallying around
description: An audience panel, a blind reviewer panel, conditional follow-up review, and an explicit recommendation.

game.description: A macro-focused RTS combining large industrial economies, large armies, consequential infrastructure losses, underground mining and bunkers, and eventual orbital expansion, satellites and asteroid resources.
game.audience: Adult players of automation and strategy games

study.goal: Explore candidate game names before human testing.
study.candidateStatus: Illustrative placeholder names, not names supplied by the user.
study.displayRule: No logos, prices or unequal marketing copy.

favorite.label: Name preference
favorite.instructions: Given only this profile and the game context, which candidate name would this person prefer? Evaluate from their own stated gaming preferences. Do not infer a preferred name from demographics alone.

appeal.instructions: How appealing is the described game to this profile, irrespective of its eventual name?
